items.title: FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRF) Prospective Payment System (PPS) Final Rule (CMS-1845-F)

items.curatedReason: 2027 财年住院康复机构 (IRF) 前瞻性支付系统 (PPS) 的最终规则，直接决定了 IRF 中物理治疗服务如何被报销。这对在 IRF 工作的 PT 至关重要，因为它会影响服务提供、收入和管理合规性。
items.titleZh: 2027 财年住院康复机构 (IRF) 前瞻性支付系统 (PPS) 最终规则（CMS-1845-F）
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了关于 2027 财年住院康复机构 (IRF) 前瞻性支付系统 (PPS) 的最终规则。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRF) Prospective Payment System (PPS) final rule directly dictates how physical therapy services in IRFs will be reimbursed. This is critical for PTs working in IRFs, as it impacts service delivery, revenue, and compliance.

Its direct relevance to physical therapists' clinical practice is low, as it typically does not impact the daily operations or reimbursement for PT clinics or hospital rehabilitation departments.

items.title: Effect of Visual Modification by Video See-Through Augmented Reality with REHA-Glasses on Postural Verticality in Individuals with Post-Stroke Lateropulsion.
items.summary: An exploratory single-arm study investigated whether REHA-glasses, which modify visual input based on body tilt, could correct lateropulsion in individuals with acute post-stroke lateropulsion, suggesting a potential for improving postural verticality.
items.curatedReason: 视频透视增强现实技术用于卒中后偏向推注患者显示出初步潜力。这项单臂探索性研究提示该技术可能有助于改善姿势垂直性，但其长期疗效、适用人群和与传统康复结合的策略尚待更多高质量证据确证。
items.titleZh: 视频透视增强现实眼镜对卒中后偏向推注患者姿势垂直性的视觉修正效果研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性单臂研究评估了 REHA-glasses（一种根据身体倾斜调整视觉输入的增强现实眼镜）是否能纠正急性卒中后偏向推注患者的姿势垂直性，初步结果提示其具有改善姿势垂直性的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Video see-through augmented reality shows initial promise for post-stroke lateropulsion. This single-arm exploratory study suggests its potential in improving postural verticality, but long-term efficacy, suitable patient populations, and integration with traditional rehabilitation require further high-quality evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂、探索性研究，缺乏对照组，且样本量和随访期未在摘要中明确说明，因此结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm, exploratory study lacking a control group, and the sample size and follow-up period are not clearly stated in the abstract, so results should be interpreted with caution.

items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) explored the efficacy and optimal technique of hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis. The median hydrodilatation volume across studies was 28 mL (range: 8.3-200 mL).
items.curatedReason: 关于肩周炎水扩张术，别再纠结最佳注射量了。这项纳入 44 项 RCT 的高质量系统综述表明，28 mL 的中位注射量已足够，更大剂量并无额外益处。
items.titleZh: 肩周炎水扩张术：系统综述探讨疗效与最佳技术
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 103 项研究（9951 名患者，44 项 RCT）的系统综述和 meta 分析评估了水扩张术治疗肩周炎的疗效和最佳技术。研究发现水扩张术的注射量中位数为 28 mL（范围：8.3-200 mL）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stop overthinking the optimal injection volume for hydrodilatation in adhesive capsulitis. This high-quality systematic review, incorporating 44 RCTs, indicates that a median volume of 28 mL is sufficient; larger volumes offer no additional benefit.
items.limitation: 本综述未明确报告水扩张术与其他干预措施在长期效果上的显著差异。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly report significant long-term differences in efficacy between hydrodilatation and other interventions.

items.title: Effects of resistance-band shoulder exercise on pain, range of motion, and functional disability in diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 28 diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis evaluated resistance-band shoulder exercises, showing effects on pain, range of motion, and functional disability.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的随机对照试验提示弹力带训练对糖尿病合并肩周炎患者有效。虽然样本量小，但它为这类特定人群的运动干预提供了早期证据，为后续大规模研究奠定基础。
items.titleZh: 弹力带肩部锻炼对糖尿病合并肩周炎患者疼痛、活动度及功能障碍的影响：一项初步随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 28 名糖尿病合并肩周炎成年人的初步随机对照试验评估了弹力带肩部锻炼计划的效果，结果显示其对疼痛、活动度及功能障碍有改善作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that resistance-band exercise is effective for diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis. Despite the small sample size, it provides early evidence for exercise intervention in this specific population, laying the groundwork for larger future studies.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的随机对照试验，样本量仅有 28 人，限制了结果的普遍性和统计学效力。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial with a small sample size of only 28 participants, limiting the generalizability and statistical power of the results.

items.title: Wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation: A pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 24 ischemic stroke patients investigated the safety, feasibility, and efficacy of wearable vibrotactile stimulation shirts and gloves for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation, using FMA-UE motor score as the primary outcome.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，可穿戴振动触觉刺激设备在卒中上肢康复中显示出安全性和可行性，并可能改善运动功能。虽然还需要大规模研究，但你可以开始关注这类新型设备作为传统康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣物和手套在卒中上肢康复中的应用：一项试点随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 24 名缺血性卒中患者的试点 RCT 评估了可穿戴振动触觉刺激衣物和手套在上肢康复中的安全性、可行性和有效性，主要结局指标为 Fugl-Meyer 评估上肢运动评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT indicates that wearable vibrotactile stimulation devices are safe and feasible for upper extremity stroke rehabilitation and may improve motor function. While larger studies are needed, you can start monitoring these novel devices as adjuncts to traditional rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本试点 RCT（24 名患者），其发现的疗效需要更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot RCT (24 patients), and its efficacy findings require validation in larger studies.

items.title: Could sensorimotor factors in acute low back pain explain long-term pain and disability? A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of longitudinal data from 99 participants with acute low back pain explored causal associations between pain sensitivity and erector spinae muscle activation in the acute phase and pain/disability at 6- and 12-month follow-ups.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，急性腰痛期的感觉运动因素可能预示长期疼痛和残疾，特别是腰部肌肉激活水平。在评估急性腰痛时，除了疼痛本身，还需要关注这些早期生物力学指标。
items.titleZh: 急性腰痛中的感觉运动因素能否解释长期疼痛和残疾？一项随机对照试验纵向数据的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 99 名急性腰痛患者的纵向数据二次分析，探讨了急性期疼痛敏感性和竖脊肌激活与 6 个月及 12 个月时疼痛和残疾的因果关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that sensorimotor factors in acute low back pain, particularly lumbar muscle activation, may predict long-term pain and disability. When assessing acute LBP, consider these early biomechanical indicators beyond just pain.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对急性腰痛患者的观察性研究，不能建立因果关系，且样本量为 99 人，外推性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study of acute low back pain patients, which cannot establish causality, and with a sample size of 99, generalizability requires further validation.

items.title: Motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation limit the effectiveness of voluntary corrections of asymmetry during walking after stroke
items.summary: This study with 28 individuals with chronic stroke identified biomechanical, neuromuscular, and cognitive characteristics associated with the ability to perform voluntary corrections of walking using explicit visual feedback, revealing limitations from motor impairment, balance, and muscle coactivation.
items.curatedReason: 这项 28 例研究提示，在卒中后步行训练中，不仅要关注视觉反馈，还应评估和管理患者的运动障碍、平衡缺陷及肌肉共激活模式，这可能比单纯反馈更重要。
items.titleZh: 运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制卒中后步行不对称自主纠正的有效性
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 名慢性卒中患者的研究发现，运动障碍、平衡和肌肉共激活限制了其在视觉反馈下进行步行不对称自主纠正的能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study of 28 individuals suggests that in post-stroke gait training, attention should be paid not only to visual feedback but also to assessing and managing patients' motor impairments, balance deficits, and muscle co-activation patterns, which might be more critical than feedback alone.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心横断面研究，样本量为 28 名慢性卒中患者，结果的外推性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-session, cross-sectional study with 28 chronic stroke individuals, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Beyond "Biomedical-Plus": Reclaiming the biopsychosocial model in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This commentary argues that musculoskeletal physiotherapy often implements the biopsychosocial (BPS) model as "biomedical-plus" care. It proposes that physiotherapists can achieve a more authentic BPS application through three foundational conditions: professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication.
items.curatedReason: 你的生物心理社会模型实践是否落入了“生物医学+”的窠臼？这篇评论文章强调，要真正实现整合，你需要关注专业自信（Confidence）、角色清晰（Clarity）和同情心沟通（Compassionate communication）。审视自身，提升 BPS 模型应用的深度。
items.titleZh: 超越“生物医学+”：在肌肉骨骼物理治疗中重申生物心理社会模型
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章指出，肌肉骨骼物理治疗在实践生物心理社会（BPS）模型时常陷入“生物医学+”的模式。文章提出，物理治疗师可通过建立专业自信、明确角色定位和富有同情心的沟通这三个基础条件，实现更真实的 BPS 模型应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Is your biopsychosocial model practice falling into the “biomedical-plus” trap? This commentary emphasizes that true integration requires focusing on professional Confidence, role Clarity, and Compassionate communication. Reflect on your own practice to deepen your application of the BPS model.

items.title: Exploring equity in telehealth interventions in physiotherapy: A meta-epidemiological study.
items.summary: This meta-epidemiological study assessed equity in telehealth physiotherapy interventions using the PROGRESS Plus framework, analyzing 94 randomized controlled trials from 2020-2023 to understand how telehealth addresses or exacerbates health disparities.
items.curatedReason: 远程物理治疗的公平性研究表明，尽管技术能带来便利，但在实践中仍可能存在不平等。审视你的远程治疗方案，确保你在推广和应用远程康复时，能更好地覆盖所有患者群体，避免加剧健康不公平。
items.titleZh: 探讨物理治疗中远程医疗干预的公平性：一项荟萃流行病学研究
items.summaryZh: 这项荟萃流行病学研究利用 PROGRESS Plus 框架，评估了物理治疗中远程医疗干预的公平性，分析了 2020-2023 年的 94 项随机对照试验，以了解远程医疗如何解决或加剧健康差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Research on equity in telehealth physical therapy suggests that despite technological convenience, inequalities may persist in practice. Review your telehealth protocols to ensure that when promoting and applying telerehabilitation, you can better reach all patient groups and avoid exacerbating health inequities.
items.limitation: 本研究为荟萃流行病学研究，依赖于现有 RCT 的报告质量，可能无法完全捕捉真实世界的公平性问题。
items.limitationEn: This meta-epidemiological study relies on the reporting quality of existing RCTs and may not fully capture real-world equity issues.

items.title: Spine-related leg pain: Definitions, etiology, clinical presentation, and management.
items.summary: This review clarifies inconsistent terminology in spine-related leg pain (SRLP) by detailing the International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP) classification, distinguishing between radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain.
items.curatedReason: 脊柱相关腿痛的诊断分类依然混乱，直接影响你的诊断和治疗决策。这份综述是 IASP 最新分类（根性病变、根性痛、躯体牵涉痛）的权威解读，用它统一科室内部术语，提升诊疗一致性。
items.titleZh: 脊柱相关腿痛：定义、病因、临床表现与管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述通过详细阐述国际疼痛研究协会（IASP）的分类，澄清了脊柱相关腿痛（SRLP）术语上的不一致，区分了神经根病、神经根痛和躯体牵涉痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: The diagnostic classification of spine-related leg pain remains confusing, directly impacting your diagnostic and treatment decisions. This review offers an authoritative interpretation of the latest IASP classification (radiculopathy, radicular pain, and somatic referred pain); use it to standardize terminology within your practice and improve consistency in care.

items.title: Digital Addiction and Body Balance: An Investigation of Postural Stability in Young Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 74 young adults found that smartphone addiction is associated with impaired postural balance, especially during attention-demanding tasks, highlighting the need for physiotherapy in managing its effects.
items.curatedReason: 数字成瘾的年轻患者越来越多，他们的步态和姿态问题可能不是简单的体态不良。这项研究提示，需要把数字成瘾纳入鉴别诊断，并针对性地评估和干预平衡控制能力。
items.titleZh: 数字成瘾与身体平衡：一项针对年轻成人姿势稳定性的调查：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 74 名年轻成年人的横断面研究发现，智能手机成瘾与姿势平衡受损有关，尤其在需要集中注意力的任务中更为明显，这强调了物理治疗在管理数字成瘾影响方面的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: With the increasing number of young patients with digital addiction, their gait and posture issues might not be simple postural problems. This study suggests that digital addiction should be included in differential diagnoses, and balance control should be specifically assessed and intervened upon.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立数字成瘾与姿势稳定性的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish a causal relationship between digital addiction and postural stability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Safety of Early Rehabilitation Dose After Stroke on Composite Outcomes: Analysis of Nationwide Japanese Medical Claims Data.
items.summary: This study, using nationwide Japanese medical claims data (2018-2022), found that early in-hospital rehabilitation (20-60 min/day, initiated on days 1 or 2) after stroke is safe for composite outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复的剂量与安全性一直是我们关心的。这项大规模观察研究提示，入院后1-2天内开始、每天20-60分钟的康复是安全的，这能让你在临床实践中更放心地推进早期适度康复。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期康复剂量对复合结局的安全影响：日本全国医疗索赔数据分析
items.summaryZh: 这项利用日本全国医疗索赔数据（2018-2022）的研究发现，卒中后早期住院康复（每日 20-60 分钟，在入院第 1 或第 2 天开始）对复合结局是安全的。
items.curatedReasonEn: The dose and safety of early post-stroke rehabilitation are persistent concerns. This large-scale observational study suggests that rehabilitation initiated within 1-2 days of admission, for 20-60 minutes/day, is safe. This finding should empower you to more confidently advance early, moderate-dose rehabilitation in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 该研究基于医疗索赔数据，可能存在混杂因素和信息偏差，且结果主要适用于日本医疗体系。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on medical claims data, which may have confounding factors and information bias, and the results are primarily applicable to the Japanese healthcare system.

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes advances in spinal connectomics and neuroengineering, highlighting the spinal cord's role in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control, driven by machine learning and advanced imaging.
items.curatedReason: 了解脊髓连接组学（spine connectomics）的最新进展，有助于你更好地理解脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的复杂作用。这篇综述为你在处理复杂脊柱损伤或神经功能障碍时，提供了更深层的理论依据。
items.titleZh: 通过机器学习和神经工程学推进脊髓连接组学和神经整合：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了脊髓连接组学和神经工程学的进展，强调了在机器学习和先进成像的推动下，脊髓在感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the latest advancements in spine connectomics will help you better grasp the complex role of the spinal cord in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control. This review provides deeper theoretical grounds for managing complex spinal injuries or neurological dysfunctions.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and does not involve systematic evidence appraisal.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study identified that beyond motor impairment, factors such as proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy explain limited daily hand-use in post-stroke individuals with fair-to-good motor ability.
items.curatedReason: 即使卒中患者上肢运动能力良好，日常手功能使用受限依然常见。这项研究提示，除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等非运动因素也是重要影响因素。你在评估和干预时，需要把这些因素考虑在内。
items.titleZh: 解释卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的因素
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究发现，除了运动障碍，本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等因素也解释了卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even with good upper extremity motor ability, limited daily hand use is common in stroke patients. This study suggests that non-motor factors like proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy are significant influences beyond motor impairment. You need to consider these factors in your assessments and interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立所评估因素与日常手功能使用限制的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish a causal relationship between the assessed factors and limited daily hand use.

items.title: Lifestyle medicine innovations: Physical activity assessment in patient care and implementation of a digital health platform to support healthier movement.
items.summary: This narrative review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform as a scalable approach to integrate personalized physical activity and home exercise into clinical care, utilizing the Physical Activity Vital Sign (PAVS) within an academic healthcare system.
items.curatedReason: 数字健康平台正在成为支持患者进行个性化身体活动和居家锻炼的新趋势。了解 ExerciseRxTM 平台如何将“身体活动生命体征”整合进电子病历，能让你思考未来如何在临床实践中利用数字化工具促进患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 生活方式医学创新：患者护理中的身体活动评估及数字健康平台在支持更健康运动中的实施
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台，它作为一种可扩展的方法，将个性化身体活动和居家锻炼整合到临床护理中，并在学术医疗系统中利用身体活动生命体征（PAVS）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Digital health platforms are emerging as a new trend to support personalized physical activity and home exercise for patients. Understanding how the ExerciseRxTM platform integrates "Physical Activity Vital Signs" into electronic health records can help you consider how to leverage digital tools in clinical practice to promote patient adherence in the future.
items.limitation: 本评论为叙述性综述，主要介绍平台概念和应用，缺乏客观的疗效评估和临床数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, primarily introducing the platform concept and its applications, lacking objective efficacy evaluation and clinical data.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: 河南省人民政府办公厅关于印发河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案的通知-健康界
items.summary: Henan Province, China, issued an implementation plan for establishing a long-term care insurance system, aiming to fully establish the system across the province within about three years to cover employees, retirees, flexible workers, and unemployed urban and rural residents.
items.curatedReason: 河南省出台长期护理保险制度实施方案，标志着中国在长期护理保障方面迈出了重要一步。如果你在中国执业或关注中国市场，你需要了解这项政策对物理治疗服务，特别是老年康复和居家康复报销的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 河南省人民政府办公厅关于印发河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案的通知
items.summaryZh: 中国河南省人民政府办公厅印发了《河南省建立长期护理保险制度实施方案》，目标在三年内全面建立长期护理保险制度，覆盖就业人员、退休人员、灵活就业人员和未就业城乡居民。
items.curatedReasonEn: Henan Province's implementation plan for long-term care insurance marks a significant step for China in long-term care provision. If you practice in China or follow the Chinese market, you need to understand this policy's potential impact on physical therapy services, especially for geriatric and home-based rehabilitation reimbursement.

items.title: Peri-Fracture Injections Reduce Early Postoperative Pain and Opioid Use, Suggests Study
items.summary: A meta-analysis of RCTs suggests that peri-fracture site injections for distal radius and ankle fractures provide significant pain relief primarily during the early postoperative period and reduce overall opioid consumption.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析提示，骨折周围注射在早期术后镇痛和减少阿片类药物使用方面有显著效果。考虑将其作为腕骨和踝骨骨折患者围手术期管理的一部分。
items.titleZh: 研究表明骨折周围注射可减轻术后早期疼痛并减少阿片类药物使用
items.summaryZh: 一项对随机对照试验的荟萃分析发现，腕骨和踝骨骨折患者的骨折周围注射在术后早期显著缓解疼痛，并减少了阿片类药物的总消耗量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis suggests that peri-fracture injections are significantly effective for early postoperative pain relief and opioid reduction. Consider incorporating this approach into perioperative management for patients with distal radius and ankle fractures.
items.limitation: 需进一步研究以确定最佳注射方案和更持久的镇痛效果。
items.limitationEn: Further research is needed to determine optimal injection protocols and longer-lasting analgesia.

items.title: STEPS Rehabilitation among the first in Europe to introduce ARC-EX technology
items.summary: STEPS Rehabilitation in Sheffield, UK, is among the first in Europe to introduce ONWARD Medical's ARC-EX System, a technology designed to support arm and hand function recovery in individuals with incomplete spinal cord injury, approved for use in late 2025.
items.curatedReason: 英国 STEPS Rehabilitation 引进 ARC-EX 系统，标志着脊髓损伤神经康复技术的新进展。关注这类技术，有助于你了解未来辅助手臂和手功能恢复的临床工具。
items.titleZh: STEPS Rehabilitation 率先在欧洲引入 ARC-EX 技术——脊柱外科新闻
items.summaryZh: 英国谢菲尔德的 STEPS Rehabilitation 率先在欧洲引入 ONWARD Medical 的 ARC-EX 系统，该技术旨在支持不完全脊髓损伤患者的手臂和手功能恢复，并已于 2025 年底获批使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: STEPS Rehabilitation in the UK adopting the ARC-EX System marks a new advancement in spinal cord injury neurorehabilitation technology. Monitoring such technologies helps you stay informed about future clinical tools for assisting arm and hand function recovery.

items.title: Why Healthcare RCM Is Still Broken and What Comes Next
items.summary: This webinar from WebPT addresses the ongoing challenges in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) for rehab therapy, exploring current issues and future solutions.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这则网络研讨会广告聚焦于医疗收入周期管理（RCM）的痛点和未来解决方案。它提醒你作为物理治疗诊所管理者，持续关注报销和运营效率，尤其是 AI 等新技术的应用。
items.titleZh: 为什么医疗收入周期管理仍然存在问题以及接下来会发生什么
items.summaryZh: WebPT 的这场网络研讨会聚焦于康复治疗领域医疗收入周期管理（RCM）的持续挑战，探讨了当前存在的问题及未来的解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT webinar ad focuses on the pain points and future solutions in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). It reminds you, as a physical therapy clinic manager, to continuously monitor reimbursement and operational efficiency, especially the application of new technologies like AI.

items.title: Eccentric cycling for ACL-R rehabilitation: A masterclass.
items.summary: Eccentric cycling is increasingly used in ACL-R rehabilitation, with evidence suggesting potential benefits for quadriceps atrophy and strength deficits when introduced early (from 3 weeks post-op) in selected patients, also enhancing return-to-sport performance.
items.curatedReason: 离心骑行在 ACL 重建术后康复中正变得越来越重要。对于特定患者，从术后 3 周开始早期引入离心骑行，可能有助于改善股四头肌萎缩和力量不足，并提升运动表现。你可以考虑将其整合到早期康复方案中。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后康复中的离心骑行：专家课程
items.summaryZh: 离心骑行在 ACL 重建术后康复中日益普及，有证据表明，在特定患者术后约三周开始早期渐进式离心训练，对股四头肌萎缩和力量不足可能带来益处，并能提高重返运动表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Eccentric cycling is increasingly relevant in ACL-R rehabilitation. For selected patients, introducing it as early as 3 weeks post-op may mitigate quadriceps atrophy and strength deficits, potentially boosting return-to-sport performance. Consider integrating this into early rehabilitation protocols.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Perspectives of Private Practice Physical Therapy Health Care Systems Participating in a Pragmatic Clinical Trial: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of four private practice physical therapy health care systems participating in the Fibromyalgia TENS In Physical Therapy Study (FM-TIPS), highlighting experiences often overlooked in academic-centric clinical research.
items.curatedReason: 私人物理治疗诊所参与临床试验的经验，往往被学术主导的研究忽视。这项定性研究填补了空白，让我们看到私立机构在研究参与中的独特视角和挑战，有助于未来设计更具包容性的研究模式。
items.titleZh: 私人物理治疗医疗系统参与实用临床试验的视角：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了参与 FM-TIPS 临床试验的四家私人物理治疗医疗系统的视角，揭示了非学术机构在临床研究中的独特经验。
items.curatedReasonEn: The experiences of private physical therapy practices in clinical trials are often overlooked in academia-centric research. This qualitative study sheds light on their unique perspectives and challenges in research participation, which should inform the design of more inclusive study models in the future.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为 4 家美国私人物理治疗医疗系统，结果可能不具有广泛代表性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved only 4 private physical therapy health care systems in the US, so the findings may not be broadly representative.

items.title: BMJ Rapid Recommendations
items.summary: The BMJ and MAGIC are collaborating on "Rapid Recommendations" to quickly translate new research into trustworthy clinical guidelines, addressing the lag between evidence generation and its implementation in practice.
items.curatedReason: BMJ 联合 MAGIC 发布的“快速建议”旨在加速最新研究证据转化为临床实践。这是一个值得关注的指南发布渠道，你可以从中及时获取高质量的临床建议。
items.titleZh: BMJ 快速建议
items.summaryZh: 《英国医学杂志》(BMJ) 正与 MAGIC 合作推出“快速建议”项目，旨在加速新研究证据转化为可信临床指南，以应对证据与实践之间的滞后。
items.curatedReasonEn: The BMJ and MAGIC’s “Rapid Recommendations” aims to swiftly translate new research into trustworthy clinical guidelines. This is a crucial channel for accessing evidence-based practice advice quickly, circumventing the lengthy traditional guideline update cycles.

items.title: Frailty and Advanced Age Increase Risks After Surgery for Male Stress Urinary Incontinence: Study
items.summary: A study found that frailty and advanced age in older men undergoing surgery for stress urinary incontinence (artificial urinary sphincter or urethral sling) were independently associated with higher risks of 30-day complications, 1-year device revision/removal, and 1-year mortality.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在进行男性压力性尿失禁手术时，对高龄和衰弱患者进行全面术前风险评估的重要性。在术前评估中，你需要考虑这些因素对康复预后的潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 研究：衰弱和高龄增加男性压力性尿失禁术后风险
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，高龄和衰弱的男性在进行人工尿道括约肌植入或尿道吊带术治疗压力性尿失禁后，与 30 天术后并发症、一年内器械移除或翻修以及一年内死亡的较高风险独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study underscores the importance of comprehensive preoperative risk assessment for elderly and frail male patients undergoing stress urinary incontinence surgery. In your preoperative evaluations, consider the potential impact of these factors on rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究未明确说明男性压力性尿失禁患者术后物理治疗的介入作用。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly state the role of physical therapy intervention for male stress urinary incontinence patients post-surgery.

items.title: Effects of a 12- week, seated, virtual, home- based tele
items.summary: This protocol outlines a 12-week randomized controlled trial comparing a seated, virtual, home-based tele-exercise program with a prerecorded video-based exercise program for individuals with chronic neurological impairments.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对慢性神经功能障碍患者的远程家庭康复随机对照试验协议。它提供了比较虚拟实时与预录视频两种远程运动方案效果的设计框架，预示了未来远程康复模式的证据方向。
items.titleZh: 为期 12 周的坐姿虚拟家庭远程运动计划与预录视频运动计划对慢性神经功能障碍患者效果的比较：一项随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案旨在比较为期 12 周的坐姿虚拟家庭远程运动计划与预录视频运动计划对慢性神经功能障碍患者的效果，为一项随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an RCT protocol for virtual home-based telerehabilitation in patients with chronic neurological impairments. It provides a design framework for comparing live virtual versus prerecorded video exercise programs, indicating the future direction of telerehabilitation evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为研究方案，尚未发布实际研究结果。
items.limitationEn: This is only a study protocol; actual research results have not yet been published.

items.title: Quantitative Infarct Volumetry Outperforms ASPECTS in Large-Core Stroke: Study
items.summary: Quantitative infarct volumetry outperformed ASPECTS in predicting biological infarct burden and clinical outcomes in large-core ischemic stroke patients undergoing thrombectomy, with infarct volumes >110 mL indicating diminished reperfusion benefit.
items.curatedReason: 在大核心缺血性卒中患者的血栓切除术中，定量梗死体积测量在预测生物学梗死负荷和临床预后方面优于 ASPECTS 评分。梗死体积超过 110 mL，再灌注获益会减弱。这意味着在预后评估时，你应更关注定量梗死体积数据。
items.titleZh: 研究：定量梗死体积测量在大核心卒中中优于 ASPECTS 评分
items.summaryZh: 一项新研究显示，在接受取栓治疗的大核心缺血性卒中患者中，定量梗死体积测量在预测生物学梗死负荷和临床预后方面优于 ASPECTS 评分，且梗死体积超过 110 mL 预示再灌注获益显著降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For large-core ischemic stroke patients undergoing thrombectomy, quantitative infarct volumetry surpasses ASPECTS in predicting biological infarct burden and clinical outcomes. Infarct volumes over 110 mL indicate diminished reperfusion benefit. This implies you should prioritize quantitative infarct volume data in prognosis assessment.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是溶栓治疗患者的预后预测，而非康复干预的直接效果。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on prognostic prediction for thrombolysis patients, not the direct effects of rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: traumatic brain injury
items.summary: A retrospective study found that amantadine treatment was associated with improved consciousness in patients with non-traumatic brain injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提示，金刚烷胺可能与非创伤性脑损伤患者意识改善相关。如果你在临床中遇到这类患者，可以关注金刚烷胺的辅助治疗潜力。
items.titleZh: 金刚烷胺治疗与非创伤性脑损伤患者意识改善相关
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究发现，金刚烷胺治疗与非创伤性脑损伤患者意识的改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that amantadine may be associated with improved consciousness in patients with non-traumatic brain injury. If you encounter such patients in clinical practice, you might consider the potential for amantadine as an adjunctive therapy.
items.limitation: 该研究为回顾性观察研究，因果关系尚待高级别证据确认。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective observational study, and causality needs confirmation with higher-level evidence.

items.title: DNT达标率超92%！管理革新如何赋能卒中救治？-健康界
items.summary: Qinhuangdao First Hospital's "5A+5M" full-cycle stroke management system achieved over 92% DNT compliance, demonstrating how management innovation can empower stroke treatment by optimizing pre-hospital and in-hospital processes.
items.curatedReason: 秦皇岛市第一医院的“5A+5M”卒中管理体系使 DNT 达标率超过 92%。尽管主要针对急性期，但这种通过优化院前院内流程来赋能卒中治疗的创新管理模式和跨学科协作经验，非常值得你的卒中康复团队借鉴。
items.titleZh: DNT 达标率超92%！管理革新如何赋能卒中救治？
items.summaryZh: 秦皇岛市第一医院的“5A+5M”卒中全周期管理体系实现了超过 92% 的 DNT 达标率，展示了管理创新如何通过优化院前院内流程来提升卒中救治能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Qinhuangdao First Hospital's "5A+5M" comprehensive stroke management system has achieved over 92% DNT compliance. While focused on acute thrombolysis, the innovative management approach and interdisciplinary collaboration experience offer valuable insights for your stroke rehabilitation team.
items.limitation: 该管理体系主要关注急性期溶栓救治，对康复阶段的具体影响需要进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: This management system primarily focuses on acute thrombolysis. Its specific impact on the rehabilitation phase requires further evaluation.

items.title: Sports-Related Peripheral Nerve Injuries
items.summary: This review discusses sports-related peripheral nerve injuries, which can occur through various acute and chronic mechanisms in athletes.
items.curatedReason: 运动员的运动相关性周围神经损伤并不少见，机制复杂多样。在评估和治疗运动损伤时，请务必将其纳入鉴别诊断，因为漏诊或误诊可能导致长期功能障碍，并影响运动员的职业生涯。
items.titleZh: 运动相关周围神经损伤
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了运动员中运动相关的周围神经损伤，这类损伤可通过多种急性和慢性机制发生。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sports-related peripheral nerve injuries in athletes are not uncommon and have diverse mechanisms. When evaluating and treating sports injuries, always include them in your differential diagnosis, as missed or misdiagnosed cases can lead to long-term dysfunction and impact an athlete's career.

items.title: Wearable Heart Rate Variability Monitoring, Autonomic Dysfunction and Post-exertional Malaise in Long COVID: An Observational Study
items.summary: An observational study investigated wearable heart rate variability monitoring, autonomic dysfunction, and post-exertional malaise in patients with Long COVID, aiming to assess autonomic function and monitor overexertion.
items.curatedReason: 对于长新冠患者的自主神经功能障碍和劳力后不适，可穿戴心率变异性监测可能是一个有用的工具。这项观察性研究提示，你可以考虑利用这类技术来客观评估患者的自主神经功能，并指导其活动管理，以避免过度劳累。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴心率变异性监测、自主神经功能障碍和长新冠患者劳力后不适：一项观察性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究旨在评估可穿戴心率变异性监测在长新冠患者自主神经功能、劳力后不适以及过度劳累监测中的应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Wearable heart rate variability monitoring may be a useful tool for autonomic dysfunction and post-exertional malaise in Long COVID patients. This observational study suggests you could consider using such technology to objectively assess autonomic function and guide activity management to prevent overexertion.
items.limitation: 研究设计为观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The study design is observational, so it cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by confounding factors.

items.title: APTA Master Class Series Brings Immersive, In-Person Learning to PTs and PTAs
items.summary: APTA is launching a Master Class Series offering immersive, in-person learning for PTs and PTAs, designed to provide practical skills for evolving practice in response to new technologies, payment models, and patient needs.
items.curatedReason: APTA 的大师班系列提供沉浸式、面对面的学习体验，帮助物理治疗师和物理治疗助理提升实践技能。如果你寻求高质量的继续教育，这会是一个值得考虑的选项。
items.titleZh: APTA 大师班系列为物理治疗师和物理治疗助理带来沉浸式线下学习体验
items.summaryZh: APTA 推出大师班系列，为物理治疗师和物理治疗助理提供沉浸式线下学习体验，旨在应对新技术、支付模式和患者需求变化，提供实用的实践技能。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's Master Class Series offers immersive, in-person learning experiences to help physical therapists and PTAs enhance practical skills. If you're seeking high-quality continuing education, this is a valuable option to consider.

items.title: COVID Lockdown Births Linked to Lower Executive Function at Age 4: Study
items.summary: An observational study of over 200 UK children born during the COVID-19 lockdown found that 4-year-olds had lower executive function than pre-pandemic norms, with mixed language outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，英国疫情封锁期间出生的 4 岁儿童，其执行功能可能低于疫情前水平。我们应警惕疫情相关的环境因素，并考虑在这些儿童的早期评估中，加入针对执行功能的筛查。
items.titleZh: 研究：疫情封锁期出生儿童 4 岁时执行功能可能较低
items.summaryZh: 一项对 200 多名在英国疫情封锁期间出生的儿童进行的观察性研究发现，这些儿童在 4 岁时执行功能低于疫情前常模，且语言发展结果不一。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that 4-year-old children born during the UK's COVID-19 lockdown may have lower executive function compared to pre-pandemic norms. We should be mindful of pandemic-related environmental factors and consider including executive function screening in early assessments for these children.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性，无法确立因果关系，且结果可能受多种社会经济和家庭因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The study is observational and cannot establish causality; results may be influenced by various socioeconomic and family factors.

items.title: Pediatric Humeral Shaft Fractures: Distal, Oblique Patterns May Increase Risk of Poor Radial Nerve Outcomes, Finds Review
items.summary: A review found that distal and oblique humeral shaft fractures in children were more frequently associated with poorer outcomes following radial nerve injury compared to adults, highlighting the importance of early nerve assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述提示儿童肱骨干骨折中，远端和斜形骨折模式与桡神经预后不佳的风险更高。在儿科康复中，你需要更仔细地评估这些特定类型的骨折，并密切监测桡神经功能。
items.titleZh: 儿科肱骨干骨折：综述发现远端、斜形骨折模式可能增加桡神经预后不良风险
items.summaryZh: 一项综述发现，与成人相比，儿童的远端和斜形肱骨干骨折更容易导致桡神经损伤后预后不佳，强调了早期神经评估的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review suggests that distal and oblique humeral shaft fracture patterns in children are associated with a higher risk of poor radial nerve outcomes. In pediatric rehabilitation, you need to assess these specific fracture types more carefully and closely monitor radial nerve function.
items.limitation: 这是一项综述性研究，可能包含不同研究设计和质量的证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a review study and may include evidence of varying study designs and quality.

items.title: Teriparatide plus zoledronic acid may increase BMD but may not Reduce Fractures in Osteogenesis Imperfecta: Study
items.summary: A new RCT in adults with osteogenesis imperfecta found that teriparatide plus zoledronic acid significantly increased bone mineral density (BMD) but did not reduce fracture risk compared to standard care, suggesting impaired bone quality plays a key role.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，特立帕肽联合唑来膦酸虽然能增加成骨不全患者的骨密度，但未能降低骨折风险。这提醒你，在成骨不全的康复管理中，不能仅仅关注骨密度，还需要考虑骨质量的整体改善。
items.titleZh: 研究：特立帕肽加唑来膦酸或可增加成骨不全患者骨密度但未能减少骨折
items.summaryZh: 一项针对成骨不全成人患者的新随机临床试验发现，特立帕肽联合唑来膦酸显著增加了骨矿物质密度（BMD），但与标准治疗相比并未降低骨折风险，这表明骨质量受损在骨折风险中扮演关键角色。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that while teriparatide combined with zoledronic acid increased bone mineral density in osteogenesis imperfecta patients, it did not reduce fracture risk. This reminds you that in managing osteogenesis imperfecta rehabilitation, focusing solely on bone density is insufficient; overall bone quality improvement must also be considered.
items.limitation: 研究结果仅限于特立帕肽联合唑来膦酸这一特定药物组合，不代表所有干预措施。
items.limitationEn: The study results are limited to the specific drug combination of teriparatide and zoledronic acid and do not represent all interventions.

items.title: The vertebral artery loops: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis estimated the pooled prevalence of vertebral artery loops (VALs), focal deviations of the vertebral artery course that may cause pulsatile nerve-root compression and increase iatrogenic vascular injury risk during cervical spine procedures.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了椎动脉袢（VALs）的患病率。了解 VALs 对颈椎手术风险的影响，有助于你在评估颈痛患者或术前评估时提高警惕，尤其是在涉及颈椎手法治疗时。
items.titleZh: 椎动脉袢：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了椎动脉袢（VALs）的总患病率。VALs 是椎动脉走行中的局灶性偏离，可能导致搏动性神经根压迫，并显著增加颈椎手术中医源性血管损伤的风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis assessed the prevalence of vertebral artery loops (VALs). Understanding the impact of VALs on cervical spine surgery risk helps you maintain vigilance when evaluating neck pain patients or during preoperative assessments, especially with cervical manual therapy.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是椎动脉袢的流行病学和解剖学风险，而非手法治疗本身的直接安全性。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on the epidemiology and anatomical risks of vertebral artery loops, not the direct safety of manual therapy itself.

items.title: Assessment of return to play after an acute shoulder injury
items.summary: This protocol outlines an explorative prospective observational German multicenter study to assess return to play after acute shoulder injury.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项关于急性肩关节损伤重返运动评估的观察性研究协议，虽然只是协议，但揭示了该领域在德国的关注点和研究设计方向。
items.titleZh: 急性肩关节损伤后重返运动的评估：一项德国多中心探索性前瞻性观察研究方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案旨在介绍一项德国多中心探索性前瞻性观察研究，评估急性肩关节损伤后重返运动的情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an observational study on return-to-play assessment after acute shoulder injury. While only a protocol, it highlights the focus and research design in this field in Germany.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为研究方案，尚未发布实际研究结果。
items.limitationEn: This is only a study protocol; actual research results have not yet been published.

items.title: Data and code (Un)availability in sports meta-analysis studies - ScienceDirect
items.summary: Only 34% of sports meta-analyses included a data availability statement and 13% a code statement, with only 33% sharing data and 11% sharing code, despite journal policies.
items.curatedReason: 尽管期刊有明确政策，运动学荟萃分析中数据和代码的共享率依然很低（数据共享仅 33%，代码共享仅 11%）。这提示你在评估运动康复领域的证据时，需对研究的可重复性和透明度保持高度警惕，谨防潜在偏倚。
items.titleZh: 运动荟萃分析研究中数据和代码的（不可）用性
items.summaryZh: 尽管有期刊政策要求，但仅有 34% 的运动学荟萃分析包含数据可用性声明，13% 包含代码声明，且仅有 33% 的研究共享了数据，11% 共享了代码。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite journal policies, data and code sharing remain low in sports meta-analyses (only 33% for data, 11% for code). This warns you to be highly vigilant about research reproducibility and transparency when evaluating evidence in sports rehabilitation, guarding against potential biases.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的是荟萃分析的数据共享实践，而非临床干预本身。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on data sharing practices in meta-analyses, not clinical interventions themselves.

items.title: AOT study protocol of a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This protocol outlines the PAM-AOT study, a randomized controlled trial investigating if a pathological model can improve paretic hand abilities in hemiplegic children.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对偏瘫儿童手功能康复的 RCT 方案。虽然只是协议，但它提示我们，未来可能会有新的证据表明结合病理模型的方法，在患侧手能力改善上，与现有疗法相比，有更好的效果。
items.titleZh: 病理模型能否改善偏瘫儿童患侧手的能力？PAM-AOT 研究随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究协议是 PAM-AOT 研究，一项随机对照试验，旨在探讨病理模型是否能改善偏瘫儿童患侧手的功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol for paretic hand rehabilitation in hemiplegic children suggests that a pathological model approach might, in the future, show superior efficacy in improving paretic hand abilities compared to existing therapies.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为研究方案，尚未发布实际研究结果。
items.limitationEn: This is only a study protocol; actual research results have not yet been published.

items.title: Online First
items.summary: Thorax's "Online First" section updates with the latest research in respiratory medicine, including studies on asthma and COPD, providing early access to published articles.
items.curatedReason: 《胸腔》杂志的“在线优先”文章列表，你可以快速浏览呼吸系统疾病如哮喘、慢阻肺的最新进展。但多数是药物或流行病学研究，对康复治疗的直接指导有限，权作背景知识更新即可。
items.titleZh: 在线优先
items.summaryZh: 《胸腔》杂志的“在线优先”栏目实时更新呼吸医学领域的最新研究，包括哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）等疾病的研究，提供已发表文章的早期访问。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thorax's "Online First" section offers quick access to the latest research in respiratory diseases like asthma and COPD. However, most articles focus on pharmacological or epidemiological studies, providing limited direct guidance for rehabilitation therapy. Use it primarily for background knowledge updates.

items.title: Tozorakimab Reduces COPD Exacerbations via IL-33 Blockade in Phase 3 trial
items.summary: A Phase 3 trial revealed that Tozorakimab, by blocking IL-33, reduced COPD exacerbations.
items.curatedReason: 这项 3 期临床试验显示 Tozorakimab 通过 IL-33 阻断可减少 COPD 急性加重。虽然是药物研究，但药物治疗进展对 COPD 患者的整体健康状态有影响，间接影响康复目标。
items.titleZh: Tozorakimab 在 3 期试验中通过 IL-33 阻断减少 COPD 急性加重
items.summaryZh: 一项 3 期临床试验显示，Tozorakimab 通过阻断白细胞介素-33（IL-33）减少了慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的急性加重。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Phase 3 trial shows Tozorakimab reduces COPD exacerbations via IL-33 blockade. While a drug study, pharmacological advancements impact the overall health status of COPD patients, indirectly influencing rehabilitation goals.
items.limitation: 本研究为药物试验，与物理治疗干预无直接相关性。
items.limitationEn: This is a drug trial and has no direct relevance to physical therapy interventions.

items.title: Tezepelumab Improves Functional Exercise Capacity and Asthma Control in Severe Asthma: PEACE-24 Study
items.summary: The PEACE-24 Study found that tezepelumab significantly improved functional exercise capacity and asthma control in patients with severe asthma after 24 weeks of therapy, associated with better lung function, reduced breathlessness, and improved quality of life.
items.curatedReason: PEACE-24 研究显示 Tezepelumab 可改善重度哮喘患者的功能运动能力和哮喘控制。作为物理治疗师，了解这些药物治疗的进展有助于你更好地配合患者的整体管理，尤其是运动康复方面。
items.titleZh: Tezepelumab 改善重度哮喘患者功能运动能力和哮喘控制：PEACE-24 研究
items.summaryZh: PEACE-24 研究发现，Tezepelumab 治疗 24 周后显著改善了重度哮喘患者的功能运动能力和哮喘控制，这与肺功能改善、呼吸困难减轻和生活质量提升相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PEACE-24 Study showed Tezepelumab improved functional exercise capacity and asthma control in severe asthma patients. As a physical therapist, understanding these pharmacological advancements helps you better coordinate with patients' overall management, especially in exercise rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为药物试验，与物理治疗干预无直接相关性。
items.limitationEn: This is a drug trial and has no direct relevance to physical therapy interventions.

items.title: A systematic review of current evidence on clinical outcomes of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques in sacroiliac joint dysfunction.
items.summary: This appears to be a protocol for a systematic review of lumbar roll and modified SIMS manipulation techniques for sacroiliac joint dysfunction, registered on PROSPERO with a search period through 2025.
items.curatedReason: 本研究的注册号显示该综述的检索时间是 2021-2025 年，但文章发表日期是 2026 年，且 PROSPERO 注册号显示为 CRD420251253094，表明这是对未来研究的计划，而非已完成的系统综述。目前尚无实际的临床结果可供评估。
items.titleZh: 腰骶部旋转手法和改良 SIMS 手法治疗骶髂关节功能障碍的临床结局系统综述：一项计划
items.summaryZh: 这似乎是一项针对腰骶部旋转手法和改良 SIMS 手法治疗骶髂关节功能障碍的系统综述协议，已在 PROSPERO 注册，检索时间涵盖至 2025 年。
items.curatedReasonEn: The study's registration number indicates the review's search period is 2021-2025, but the publication date is 2026. The PROSPERO registration number CRD420251253094 suggests this is a protocol for a future study, not a completed systematic review. There are no actual clinical outcomes available for evaluation at this time.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2027 Medicare Inpatient Psychiatric Facility Prospective Payment System Final Rule (CMS-1847-F)
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has released the Fiscal Year 2027 Medicare Inpatient Psychiatric Facility Prospective Payment System Final Rule.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 公告关于 2027 财年医疗保险住院精神病设施前瞻性支付系统最终规则，直接影响康复机构的运营和报销。了解这些更新有助于你规划机构的财务和合规策略。
items.titleZh: 了解 2027 财年医疗保险住院精神病设施前瞻性支付系统最终规则 (CMS-1847-F)
items.summaryZh: 医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了 2027 财年医疗保险住院精神病设施前瞻性支付系统的最终规则。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS announcement about the Fiscal Year 2027 Medicare Inpatient Psychiatric Facility Prospective Payment System Final Rule directly impacts the operations and reimbursement of rehabilitation facilities. Understanding these updates will help you plan your facility's financial and compliance strategies.

items.title: Authors' reply to: letter to the editor: occupational therapy at home E-rehabilitation (OTHER): a feasibility study of post-stroke intervention for transition to home.
items.summary: This is an authors' reply to a letter to the editor concerning a feasibility study on post-stroke home e-rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这份回复是对先前一篇关于卒中后居家康复可行性研究的编者信的回复。它本身不是一项新的研究发现，无法提供可用于临床实践的独立信息。
items.titleZh: 作者回复：致编辑的信函：居家职业治疗电子康复 (OTHER)：一项卒中后居家干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇作者回复，针对此前一篇关于卒中后居家电子康复可行性研究的编者信。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an authors' reply to a letter to the editor regarding a feasibility study on post-stroke home e-rehabilitation. It does not present new research findings and cannot provide independent information applicable to clinical practice.

items.title: Characteristics and Specific Aspects of the Therapeutic Alliance in Physiotherapy Care: A Qualitative Study in France.
items.summary: This qualitative study conducted in France explores the specific characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy, highlighting unique relational dynamics related to touch and physical activity that distinguish it from psychological frameworks.
items.curatedReason: 理解法国物理治疗背景下治疗联盟的特点，能让你更精细地优化与患者的沟通和互动，特别是手法治疗和运动处方中信任感的建立。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗照护中治疗联盟的特点与特殊性：一项法国定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在法国进行的定性研究探讨了物理治疗中治疗联盟的特有特点，强调了与触摸和体育活动相关的独特关系动态，使其区别于心理学框架。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the characteristics of the therapeutic alliance within the French physiotherapy context allows you to fine-tune patient communication and interaction, particularly in building trust during manual therapy and exercise prescription.
items.limitation: 本研究为法国的定性研究，其发现的治疗联盟特点可能受文化背景影响，外推至其他国家或文化存在局限。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study conducted in France, the identified characteristics of the therapeutic alliance may be culturally influenced, limiting direct generalizability to other countries or cultures.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Weight Bearing Decisions After Tibial Plateau Fractures: A Literature Review Based on Clinical Perspective for Physiotherapists in India.
items.summary: This literature review offers a clinical perspective for physiotherapists in India, proposing a practical framework for weight-bearing decision-making after tibial plateau fractures, addressing the lack of India-specific guidance and the conflation of early mobilization with early weight bearing.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床视点综述是为印度当地 PT 执业情境量身定制的，在没有统一的早期负重指南时，可参考其提出的框架来做临床决策，但别直接外推到其他市场。
items.titleZh: 胫骨平台骨折后负重决策：基于印度物理治疗师临床视角的文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这份文献综述为印度物理治疗师提供了一个临床视角，提出了胫骨平台骨折后负重决策的实用框架，以解决印度特异性指导的缺失以及早期活动与早期负重混淆的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical perspective review, tailored for the Indian PT practice context, offers a valuable framework for weight-bearing decision-making in the absence of standardized early weight-bearing guidelines. Avoid direct extrapolation to other markets.
items.limitation: 本综述专门针对印度市场临床实践，其结论和框架可能不完全适用于其他医疗系统或经济体。
items.limitationEn: This review is specifically tailored to clinical practice in the Indian market; its conclusions and framework may not be fully applicable to other healthcare systems or economies.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: A cluster randomized clinical trial found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) for neck and/or shoulder pain was cost-effective compared to usual physiotherapy, providing superior clinical outcomes at comparable costs in 136 patients.
items.curatedReason: 分层物理治疗结合数字健康（SBPA）对颈肩痛的成本效益是明确的，并且与常规物理治疗相比，在成本相当的情况下效果更优。这支持了在临床实践中推广这种整合了风险分层与数字工具的混合式康复模式。
items.titleZh: 分层物理治疗结合数字健康与常规物理治疗治疗颈肩痛的成本效益：一项整群随机临床试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项整群随机临床试验结果显示，在136名颈肩痛患者中，分层混合式物理治疗（SBPA）与常规物理治疗相比，具有成本效益，并能在相似成本下提供更优的临床结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: The cost-effectiveness of Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) for neck and shoulder pain is clear, demonstrating superior outcomes at comparable costs when compared to usual physiotherapy. This evidence supports the broader adoption of this integrated, risk-stratified digital health rehabilitation model in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（139名患者），且结果主要在荷兰初级保健环境中得出，可能影响其在其他医疗体系和人群中的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (139 patients) and its primary conduct within a Dutch primary care setting may limit the generalizability of its findings to other healthcare systems and populations.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Why Reducing Therapist Burnout Should Be a Priority for Rehab Therapy Practices
items.summary: This article discusses the importance of prioritizing therapist burnout reduction for rehab therapy practices to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
items.curatedReason: 治疗师职业倦怠是影响康复服务质量和机构运营效率的现实问题。优先解决这一问题能直接提升团队士气、改善患者体验，并可能降低人员流失。
items.titleZh: 为什么减少治疗师职业倦怠应成为康复治疗机构的优先事项
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了康复治疗机构将减少治疗师职业倦怠作为优先事项的重要性，旨在提升服务质量和运营效率。
items.curatedReasonEn: Therapist burnout is a real issue impacting the quality of rehabilitation services and operational efficiency. Prioritizing its reduction directly boosts team morale, improves patient experience, and can decrease staff turnover.

items.title: Positive Psychology Interventions for Adults with Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies with 8288 retrieved records investigated the effect of positive psychology interventions (PPIs) on health and wellbeing outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury (SCI), including studies published between 2000 and 2025.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤患者的心理健康与身体康复同等重要。这份系统综述和荟萃分析提示，积极心理学干预（PPIs）是改善 SCI 患者福祉的有效手段，你可以考虑将其整合到整体康复计划中。
items.titleZh: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤成年患者的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析对 8 项研究（共检索到 8288 条记录）进行了分析，评估了积极心理学干预（PPIs）对脊髓损伤（SCI）成年患者健康和福祉结局的影响，纳入了 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mental health is as crucial as physical recovery for spinal cord injury patients. This systematic review and meta-analysis suggests that positive psychology interventions (PPIs) are an effective means to improve the well-being of SCI patients; you might consider integrating them into holistic rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 纳入的 8 项研究在方法学和干预措施上可能存在较高异质性，影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The 8 included studies might have high heterogeneity in methodology and interventions, affecting the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An individualized swimming and education program with telehealth physiotherapy showed a trend towards reduced disability at 8 weeks for chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性腰痛患者，合并了远程物理治疗的个体化游泳教育项目在8周时可能优于单纯教育。但目前仅是趋势，尤其是在 telehealth 模式下，还需要更多高质量研究来证实其临床价值。
items.titleZh: 个体化游泳与教育项目（EduSwim）治疗慢性腰痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 一项结合远程物理治疗的个体化游泳教育项目，在8周时与单纯教育相比，对慢性腰痛患者的残疾改善显示出积极趋势。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, an individualized swimming and education program with telehealth physiotherapy may offer benefits over education alone at 8 weeks. However, this is currently a trend, especially within a telehealth model, requiring further high-quality studies to confirm its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了8周的短期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term efficacy at 8 weeks.

items.title: Virtual Reality-assisted Physiotherapeutic Training for Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that virtual reality (VR)-assisted physiotherapy significantly improved pain (SMD = 0.40), physical function (SMD = 0.37), and balance (SMD = 0.44) in patients with knee osteoarthritis compared to traditional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 此系统综述与荟萃分析表明，VR辅助物理疗法在改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛、身体功能和平衡方面，显著优于传统康复。鉴于其积极效果和良好的循证基础，VR训练值得在临床中推广应用。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助下的物理治疗训练对膝骨关节炎患者的疗效：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.titleEn: Virtual Reality-assisted Physiotherapeutic Training for Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析显示，虚拟现实（VR）辅助物理疗法在改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛（SMD = 0.40）、身体功能（SMD = 0.37）和平衡（SMD = 0.44）方面，显著优于传统康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis indicates that VR-assisted physiotherapy significantly outperforms traditional rehabilitation in improving pain, physical function, and balance for patients with knee osteoarthritis. Given its positive effects and strong evidence base, VR training is recommended for clinical adoption.
items.limitation: 分析纳入的 RCT 数量较少（5项）。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis included a small number of RCTs (5).
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories and rehabilitation outcomes in post-stroke hemiplegia.
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal study identified distinct post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories in patients with post-stroke hemiplegia, with certain trajectories associated with poorer motor recovery and exercise adherence.
items.curatedReason: 研究提示，中风偏瘫患者出院后可能存在不同的恐惧运动症（kinesiophobia）发展轨迹，特定轨迹与较差的运动恢复和运动依从性相关。这提示我们，在康复过程中，应密切关注患者的心理因素，可能需要早期干预以改善预后。
items.titleZh: 中风偏瘫患者出院后恐惧运动症轨迹及其康复结局
items.titleEn: Post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories and rehabilitation outcomes in post-stroke hemiplegia
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心前瞻性纵向研究确定了296例中风偏瘫患者出院后6个月的恐惧运动症（kinesiophobia）轨迹，并发现某些轨迹与较差的运动恢复和运动依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests distinct post-discharge kinesiophobia trajectories may exist in patients with post-stroke hemiplegia, with certain trajectories linked to poorer motor recovery and exercise adherence. This indicates that psychological factors should be closely monitored during rehabilitation, potentially requiring early interventions to improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心前瞻性队列研究。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center prospective longitudinal study.

items.title: The RESOLVE Trial: A Stepped-Wedge, Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effects of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Psychologically Informed Physical Therapy on Low Back Pain Outcomes in Service Members and Veterans.
items.summary: The RESOLVE trial, a multisite, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial, evaluated a combined clinical practice guideline and psychologically informed physical therapy (CPG+PIPT) strategy, finding it effective in reducing low back pain-related disability and pain in service members and veterans.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心、分层随机试验验证了结合临床实践指南和心理知情物理治疗（CPG+PIPT）的实施策略对降低军人及退伍军人腰痛相关残疾和疼痛的有效性。它支持将心理因素纳入腰痛康复常规。
items.titleZh: RESOLVE 试验：一项分层随机试验，评估临床实践指南和心理知情物理治疗对军人及退伍军人腰痛结局的影响
items.summaryZh: RESOLVE 试验是一项多中心、分层、群组随机临床试验，旨在评估结合临床实践指南和心理知情物理治疗（CPG+PIPT）的实施策略对降低军人及退伍军人腰痛相关残疾、疼痛及下游医疗利用的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multisite, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial validates a combined CPG+PIPT implementation strategy for reducing LBP-related disability and pain in service members and veterans. It supports integrating psychological factors into routine LBP rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项分层随机试验，结果的解读需考虑其设计复杂性。
items.limitationEn: This was a stepped-wedge cluster-randomized trial, and interpretation of results should consider its complex design.

items.title: Long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation for chronic lateral elbow pain: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blinded, sham-controlled trial (n=49) demonstrated mid- and long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation applied to the radial nerve, combined with exercise, for chronic lateral elbow pain in terms of pain intensity, disability, and psychological outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 超声引导下经皮电神经刺激联合运动对慢性肱骨外上髁炎的长期益处得到了 RCT 支持。下次遇到久治不愈的网球肘患者，可以考虑这一联合治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 超声引导下经皮电神经刺激治疗慢性肱骨外上髁炎的长期益处：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照临床试验评估了超声引导下对桡神经施加经皮电神经刺激联合运动对慢性肱骨外上髁炎患者中长期疼痛强度、疼痛相关残疾、心理结局和自我感知变化的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term benefits of ultrasound-guided percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation combined with exercise for chronic lateral elbow pain are supported by this RCT. Consider this combined approach for persistent lateral epicondylitis.
items.limitation: 样本量相对较小（n=49），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small sample size (n=49) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Content validity, reliability, and agreement between in-person and video-call assessments of the modified bradykinesia rating scale (MBRS).
items.summary: A methodological study following COSMIN guidelines evaluated the Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS), finding adequate content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability, with strong agreement between in-person and video-call assessments for assessing bradykinesia components.
items.curatedReason: 修订版缓动评定量表（MBRS）在评估运动迟缓方面显示出良好的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，并且其线上视频评估与线下评估结果一致。这意味着未来在帕金森病患者评估中，远程医疗工具的可信度将进一步提高。
items.titleZh: 修订版缓动评定量表（MBRS）内容效度、信度及线上视频与线下评估一致性研究
items.summaryZh: 本方法学研究依照 COSMIN 指南，调查了修订版缓动评定量表（MBRS）评估运动迟缓（速度、幅度、节律）的内容效度、重测信度和评定者间信度，以及线下与视频通话评估的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Modified Bradykinesia Rating Scale (MBRS) demonstrates good content validity, test-retest reliability, and inter-rater reliability, with strong agreement between in-person and video-call assessments. This supports the increasing trustworthiness of telehealth tools for assessing bradykinesia in Parkinson's disease.
items.limitation: 研究样本量未明确给出具体数值，可能对外推性造成影响。
items.limitationEn: The specific sample size was not explicitly provided, which may impact generalizability.

items.title: In adult patients with brainstem strokes, does dysphagia rehabilitation improve health-related outcomes compared to usual care for inpatients? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (n=443 participants) explored the effectiveness of dysphagia rehabilitation on swallow function in adult inpatients with brainstem stroke, categorizing interventions into traditional swallowing therapy or device inclusion.
items.curatedReason: 对于脑干卒中患者的吞咽障碍康复，这项系统综述肯定了其对吞咽功能的有效性。它提供了当前干预措施的证据基础，支持你对这类高风险患者积极进行康复。
items.titleZh: 脑干卒中住院成年患者吞咽障碍康复是否能改善健康相关结局：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项纳入 12 项研究（443 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析，探讨了吞咽障碍康复对脑干卒中住院成年患者吞咽功能的有效性，将干预措施分为传统吞咽疗法或包含设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the effectiveness of dysphagia rehabilitation for improving swallow function in brainstem stroke patients. It provides an evidence base for current interventions, supporting your proactive rehabilitation efforts for these high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究异质性可能较高，且 meta 分析仅限于少数满足条件的 RCT，影响了总体结论的精确性和普适性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies in this review may have high heterogeneity, and meta-analyses were limited to a few eligible RCTs, affecting the precision and generalizability of the overall conclusions.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Arabic version of the lower extremity functional scale in individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders.
items.summary: This study examined the responsiveness of the Arabic version of the Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) in 74 individuals with lower extremity musculoskeletal disorders. LEFS change scores showed good correlation with other outcome measures, supporting its utility in clinical practice.
items.curatedReason: 评估量表能否响应治疗变化，是将其引入常规临床实践前的关键一步。LEFS 阿拉伯语版表现良好，为中东地区临床医师提供了工具可靠性依据。
items.titleZh: 下肢功能量表阿拉伯语版在下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的响应度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了下肢功能量表（LEFS）阿拉伯语版在 74 名下肢肌肉骨骼疾病患者中的响应度。LEFS 变化分数与其他结局指标显示出良好相关性，支持其在临床实践中的应用价值。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evaluating a scale's responsiveness to treatment changes is crucial before its routine clinical adoption. The Arabic LEFS demonstrates good responsiveness, offering clinicians in the Middle East reliable evidence for its utility.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（n=74），且随访期较短（3-4周），可能限制了其在长期康复效果评估中的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (n=74) and short follow-up period (3-4 weeks) may limit the generalizability of its findings for long-term rehabilitation outcome assessment.

items.title: Research progress on horticultural therapy in patients with post-stroke cognitive impairment: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review evaluated horticultural therapy (HT) for post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI), finding it significantly improves memory, executive function, and orientation, and categorized HT protocols into five types.
items.curatedReason: 园艺疗法在卒中后认知障碍患者中的应用仍处于早期探索阶段。目前证据主要是叙述性综述，临床实践中应谨慎评估其作为辅助手段的潜力，而非核心干预。
items.titleZh: 园艺疗法在卒中后认知障碍患者中的研究进展：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这项叙述性综述评估了园艺疗法对卒中后认知障碍患者的治疗效果，发现其显著改善记忆、执行功能和定向力，并将园艺疗法方案分为五种类型。
items.curatedReasonEn: Horticultural therapy for post-stroke cognitive impairment is still in early exploratory stages. Current evidence is primarily from narrative reviews, so consider its potential as an adjunct, not a core intervention, with caution in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚且未进行系统性证据综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and lacks systematic evidence synthesis.

items.title: The Association of Depression, Anxiety, and Quality of Life with Sexual Function in Young-to-Middle-Aged Stroke Patients: A Case-Control Study.
items.summary: This case-control study (n=60) found young-to-middle-aged stroke patients had significantly higher Arizona Sexual Experience Scale scores (19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001) and greater sexual dysfunction prevalence than controls, with a significant decline in sexual satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后性功能障碍的普遍性及其与情绪困扰和生活质量的关联再次被确认。临床实践中，对年轻至中年卒中患者应主动筛查性健康问题，并将其纳入整体康复评估，但本研究设计仅为病例对照，不提供干预策略。
items.titleZh: 抑郁、焦虑和生活质量与年轻至中年卒中患者性功能的相关性：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 这项病例对照研究（n=60）发现，年轻至中年卒中患者的性功能障碍显著高于对照组（ASEX 评分 19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），且性满足感显著下降。
items.curatedReasonEn: The prevalence of post-stroke sexual dysfunction and its link to psychological distress and quality of life is reconfirmed. In clinical practice, proactively screen for sexual health issues in young-to-middle-aged stroke patients and integrate them into overall rehabilitation assessment, but this case-control study does not provide intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例对照设计，样本量较小（n=60），可能存在混杂因素，且无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a case-control study with a small sample size (n=60), which may have confounding factors and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Information and communication technologies in implementation strategies promoting allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care: a scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review identified and mapped information and communication technologies (ICTs) used in implementation strategies for allied health professionals' guideline adherence in post-acute stroke care, categorizing them by targeted determinants of practice.
items.curatedReason: 该范围综述强调了利用信息通信技术（ICT）提升卒中后康复临床指南依从性的潜力。作为康复专业人士，应关注新技术在实践转化中的应用，思考如何利用 ICT 工具促进循证实践。
items.titleZh: 信息通信技术在促进专职医疗人员卒中急性后期护理指南依从性实施策略中的应用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述识别并映射了信息通信技术（ICT）在卒中急性后期护理中用于促进专职医疗人员指南依从性的实施策略，并根据实践决定因素对其进行分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights the potential of information and communication technologies (ICTs) to enhance adherence to post-acute stroke rehabilitation guidelines. As rehabilitation professionals, pay attention to how new technologies can be integrated into practice and how ICT tools can facilitate evidence-based practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，侧重于识别和映射信息通信技术，而非评估其干预效果的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review focused on identifying and mapping ICTs, not evaluating the effectiveness of their interventions.

items.title: Correlation of Motor-Task Related Brain Activation Changes With Motor Performance Changes Induced by Constraint-Induced Therapy After Stroke.
items.summary: This study (n=42) evaluated changes in motor-task related brain activation and functional recovery via Wolf Motor Function Test (WMFT) in hemiparetic stroke participants undergoing CIMT during subacute and chronic periods, using fMRI.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了限制性诱导运动疗法（CIMT）在卒中患者中改善运动表现的神经生理学机制证据。它支持 CIMT 的有效性，并提示其可能通过改变运动相关脑激活来实现，但 fMRI 结果对外推到所有患者和所有康复阶段需谨慎。
items.titleZh: 卒中后限制性诱导运动疗法诱导的运动任务相关脑激活变化与运动表现变化的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（n=42）通过功能磁共振成像（fMRI）评估了偏瘫卒中患者在亚急性期和慢性期接受限制性诱导运动疗法（CIMT）后，运动任务相关脑激活变化与 Wolf 运动功能测试（WMFT）所示功能恢复之间的关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides neurophysiological evidence for the mechanisms of constraint-induced movement therapy (CIMT) in improving motor performance after stroke. It supports CIMT's efficacy and suggests it may work through changes in motor-related brain activation, but fMRI results should be cautiously generalized to all patients and rehabilitation stages.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（n=42），且 fMRI 数据分析复杂，结果可能受多种因素影响，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size (n=42), and fMRI data analysis is complex, with results potentially influenced by multiple factors, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Enhancing dynamic postural stability during gait in Parkinson's disease with textured insoles and auditory cue training: a randomized controlled trial study.
items.summary: In a 6-week RCT, 27 individuals with Parkinson's disease (Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3) were randomized to textured insoles with auditory cues, textured insoles only, or control, finding the combined approach enhanced dynamic postural stability during gait more than other groups.
items.curatedReason: 对于 Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期的帕金森病患者，这项为期 6 周的 RCT 表明，结合纹理鞋垫和听觉线索能更好地改善动态姿势稳定性。与其单独使用纹理鞋垫或仅进行常规步行训练，你现在有证据考虑这种组合干预作为步态和平衡障碍患者的辅助方案。
items.titleZh: 纹理鞋垫联合听觉线索训练对帕金森病患者步态动态姿势稳定性的增强作用：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项为期 6 周的随机对照试验中，27 名帕金森病患者（Hoehn & Yahr 2.5-3 期）被随机分配至纹理鞋垫加听觉线索组、单独纹理鞋垫组或对照组，结果发现组合干预方案比其他组更能增强步态动态姿势稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For Parkinson's patients in Hoehn & Yahr stages 2.5-3, this 6-week RCT shows that textured insoles combined with auditory cues improve dynamic postural stability more effectively. Instead of using textured insoles alone or standard walking training, you now have evidence to consider this combined intervention as an adjunct for patients with gait and balance issues.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=27），且随访期较短（6周），长期效果及在更广泛帕金森病人群中的适用性有待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=27) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks); long-term effects and applicability to a broader PD population require further investigation.

items.title: Advocates, Leaders Drive Payment Momentum During APTA Payment Advocacy Summit
items.summary: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit gathered 450 advocates to build on recent state payment wins in 2025-2026, emphasizing the association's top priority: advancing payment for physical therapist services.
items.curatedReason: APTA 支付倡导峰会强调了 PT 报销政策的最新进展和未来方向。你应密切关注 APTA 在州和联邦层面的报销改革工作，这直接影响你的诊所收入和患者可及性。
items.titleZh: 倡导者、领导者在 APTA 支付倡导峰会期间推动支付改革
items.summaryZh: APTA 支付倡导峰会汇聚了 450 名倡导者，旨在巩固 2025-2026 年在州级支付方面取得的成就，并强调了该协会的首要任务：推动物理治疗师服务的支付改革。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA Payment Advocacy Summit highlighted the latest advancements and future directions in PT reimbursement policies. You should closely follow APTA's reimbursement reform efforts at both state and federal levels, as this directly impacts your clinic's revenue and patient access.

items.title: Predictors of physical and mental health in youth with disabilities: the role of Paralympic sport participation | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A study with 1,134 participants (mean age: 17.46 years) found that Paralympic sport participation significantly predicts better physical and mental health in youth with disabilities, as assessed by the SF-12 questionnaire.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 1134 名残疾青少年的研究强调了残奥运动对身心健康的益处。在为有残疾的青少年制定康复计划时，你可以考虑将参与适应性体育活动纳入其中。
items.titleZh: 残疾青少年身心健康的预测因素：残奥运动参与的作用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 1134 名残疾青少年（平均年龄：17.46 岁）的研究发现，残奥运动参与显著预测了受试者更好的身心健康，并通过 SF-12 问卷进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study involving 1,134 youth with disabilities highlights the benefits of Paralympic sport for physical and mental health. When developing rehabilitation plans for youth with disabilities, consider incorporating participation in adaptive sports activities.
items.limitation: 研究依赖自我报告的健康问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on self-reported health questionnaires, which may introduce recall bias.

items.title: Patient Education and Self-Management in Adults With Temporomandibular Disorders: Results From a Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found patient education and self-management to be effective interventions for adults with temporomandibular disorders (TMD).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述证实，患者教育和自我管理对成人颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）是有效的。你在临床实践中应优先整合这些低成本、高依从性的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 成人颞下颌关节紊乱患者教育与自我管理：系统综述与 Meta 分析结果
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 Meta 分析的系统综述发现，患者教育和自我管理是成人颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）的有效干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms that patient education and self-management are effective for adults with temporomandibular disorders (TMD). You should prioritize integrating these low-cost, high-adherence interventions into your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本系统综述可能包含不同类型和质量的原始研究。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review may include original studies of varying types and quality.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Social media behind nearly half of all racism and discrimination complaints
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) reported that social media is implicated in nearly half of all racism and discrimination complaints against health practitioners.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 报告称，近半数歧视投诉与社交媒体有关。你在使用社交媒体时，务必严格遵守专业行为准则，避免不当言论，维护你的执业形象和资质。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构：近半数种族主义和歧视投诉与社交媒体相关
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 报告称，近半数针对健康执业者的种族主义和歧视投诉与社交媒体有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) reports that nearly half of all discrimination complaints are linked to social media. When using social media, you must strictly adhere to professional conduct guidelines, avoid inappropriate remarks, and protect your professional image and credentials.

items.title: Effect of diurnal variation in single bout of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions among postmenopausal females
items.summary: This original research article explored the effect of diurnal variation in a single bout of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions among postmenopausal females, suggesting potential time-of-day influences.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本研究提示，阻力训练对绝经后女性心肺功能的影响可能存在昼夜节律。你在开具阻力训练处方时，可以把训练时间纳入考量，未来关注更大样本的研究是否会支持这一趋势。
items.titleZh: 单次阻力训练的昼夜节律对绝经后女性心肺功能影响的研究
items.summaryZh: 这项原创研究文章探讨了单次阻力训练的昼夜节律对绝经后女性心肺功能的影响，提示了训练时间可能产生的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample study suggests a potential diurnal variation in the effect of resistance training on cardiopulmonary functions in postmenopausal women. You might consider training time when prescribing resistance training, and watch for larger studies that may support this trend.
items.limitation: 本研究为单次训练的观察，未能提供长期训练的昼夜节律影响。
items.limitationEn: This study observed a single bout of training and did not provide information on the diurnal effects of long-term training.

items.title: Governor Vessel Acupuncture Shows Neuroprotective Benefits in Experimental Ischemic Stroke: Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A meta-analysis of experimental evidence suggests that acupuncture targeting the governor vessel (GV) may offer neuroprotective benefits in ischemic stroke models.
items.curatedReason: 这项基于动物实验的 Meta 分析提示，督脉针灸在缺血性卒中中可能具有神经保护作用。考虑到目前缺乏人体 RCT 证据，别将其作为常规推荐，但可探索其作为辅助干预的潜力。
items.titleZh: 督脉针灸在实验性缺血性卒中中显示神经保护益处：Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对实验证据的 Meta 分析表明，靶向督脉（GV）的针灸可能在缺血性卒中模型中提供神经保护益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This animal-based meta-analysis suggests that Governor Vessel acupuncture might offer neuroprotective benefits in ischemic stroke. Given the current lack of human RCT evidence, do not consider it a routine recommendation, but explore its potential as an adjunctive intervention.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于动物实验，结果外推到人体需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to animal experiments; results should be extrapolated to humans with caution.

items.title: Chemical Neurolysis May Provide Long-Lasting Pain Relief in AVN-Related Hip Pain: Study Shows
items.summary: A study suggests that chemical neurolysis targeting anterior hip capsular branches can provide up to six months of pain relief for patients with avascular necrosis (AVN)-related hip pain unresponsive to conservative treatment.
items.curatedReason: 对于保守治疗无效的股骨头坏死（AVN）相关髋痛患者，化学神经溶解术可能提供长达六个月的疼痛缓解。这提示我们，在传统方案受限时，它可作为一种潜在的辅助疼痛管理选项。
items.titleZh: 研究显示：化学神经溶解术可为股骨头坏死相关髋痛提供持久缓解
items.summaryZh: 一项研究表明，针对髋关节前囊分支的化学神经溶解术可以为对保守治疗无效的股骨头坏死（AVN）相关髋痛患者提供长达六个月的疼痛缓解。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with avascular necrosis (AVN)-related hip pain unresponsive to conservative treatment, chemical neurolysis may offer up to six months of pain relief. This suggests it can be a potential adjunctive pain management option when traditional conservative approaches are limited.
items.limitation: 本研究为简短的技术报告，样本量和随访期可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a brief technical report, and its sample size and follow-up period may be limited.

items.title: Medicare Part D 2027 National Average Monthly Bid Amount Information
items.summary: CMS has released information regarding the Medicare Part D 2027 National Average Monthly Bid Amount, a key metric for drug plan pricing and beneficiary costs.
items.curatedReason: Medicare Part D 的平均月度出价金额间接影响患者的药物可及性和自付费用，最终可能影响对药物治疗依从性有赖的患者康复进程。了解这类政策动态有助于你更好地与患者沟通，并理解其整体医疗成本负担。
items.titleZh: Medicare Part D 2027 年全国平均每月出价金额信息发布
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 发布了 Medicare Part D 2027 年全国平均每月出价金额信息，这是药品计划定价和受益人成本的关键指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Medicare Part D average monthly bid amount indirectly affects patients' drug accessibility and out-of-pocket costs, which can impact adherence to medication regimens crucial for rehabilitation. Understanding these policy dynamics helps you better communicate with patients and appreciate their overall healthcare cost burden.

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association is updating its clinical practice guideline for total knee arthroplasty, with the revision scheduled for 2026. This guideline, developed by a multidisciplinary group and based on a systematic review, includes 20 recommendations addressing benefits, harms, feasibility, and patient preferences.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）的这份膝关节置换术（TKA）临床实践指南，修订版定于 2026 年发布，基于系统综述，提出了 20 项建议。关注它能帮你确保 TKA 术后康复方案与最新循证实践对齐。
items.titleZh: 膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）正在修订其膝关节置换术（TKA）临床实践指南，预计 2026 年发布。该指南由多学科小组基于系统综述制定，包含 20 项涵盖益处、风险、可行性和患者偏好的建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated clinical practice guideline from APTA for total knee arthroplasty (TKA), set for revision in 2026, offers 20 recommendations based on a systematic review. Monitor this to ensure your TKA post-operative rehab protocols align with the latest evidence-based practices.

items.title: Sensory integration strategies for static balance control in older adults with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A study with 69 knee osteoarthritis patients explored sensory integration strategies in static balance control, finding potential over-reliance on visual and vestibular inputs when proprioception is challenged.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示膝骨关节炎患者在平衡控制上可能过度依赖视觉和前庭系统。这提醒您评估这类患者时，注意其在本体感觉受损情况下的平衡代偿策略。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年患者静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 69 名膝骨关节炎患者的研究发现，他们在静态平衡控制中可能存在对视觉和前庭感觉的过度依赖，尤其是在本体感觉受损时。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that patients with knee osteoarthritis may over-rely on visual and vestibular systems for balance control. This highlights the importance of assessing compensatory balance strategies in these patients, especially when proprioception is compromised.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，样本量较小，且无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study with a small sample size, and it cannot establish causality.

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded randomized controlled pilot trial (N=54) found that a 12-week app-based home exercise program, combined with educational pamphlets, positively impacted community-dwelling older adults' fall risk category compared to pamphlets alone.
items.curatedReason: 这款防跌倒 App 对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响，但仅是小样本的初步试验，外推到大规模应用前需要更多证据。目前可作为辅助工具了解。
items.titleZh: 防跌倒 App（SAFE app）对社区老年人跌倒风险分类的影响：单盲随机对照初步试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照初步试验（N=54）发现，为期 12 周的基于 App 的家庭锻炼计划结合教育手册，相较于单独使用手册，对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This falls prevention app shows a positive impact on fall risk categorization in community-dwelling older adults. However, it's a small pilot trial, and more evidence is needed before widespread adoption. Consider it an assistive tool for now.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步试验（N=54），结果的外推性有限，且随访期较短。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot trial (N=54) with limited generalizability and a short follow-up period.

items.title: Multimodal Phenotyping of Myofascial Pain Syndrome Using Rotational Shear Wave Elastography and Clinical Network Analysis
items.summary: A study involving 71 adults suggests that multi-angle shear wave elastography, combined with bioimpedance spectroscopy and patient-reported outcomes, can characterize upper-trapezius anisotropy and differentiate subgroups of myofascial pain syndrome, providing more objective phenotyping.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，旋转剪切波弹性成像 (SWE) 结合生物阻抗和患者报告结果，可以为肌筋膜疼痛综合征提供更客观、多模态的表型分析。这有助于未来精准诊断和个性化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 多模态表型分析肌筋膜疼痛综合征：旋转剪切波弹性成像与临床网络分析的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 71 名成年人的研究表明，多角度剪切波弹性成像结合生物阻抗谱和患者报告结果，可以表征斜方肌上部的各向异性，并区分肌筋膜疼痛综合征的亚组，提供更客观的表型分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that rotational shear wave elastography (SWE), combined with bioimpedance and patient-reported outcomes, can provide a more objective, multimodal phenotyping for myofascial pain syndrome. This aids in future precise diagnosis and personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，且样本量相对较小（n=71），还需要更大型的队列研究和临床试验来验证这些发现的诊断和预后价值。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with a relatively small sample size (n=71); larger cohort studies and clinical trials are needed to validate the diagnostic and prognostic value of these findings.

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 1
items.summary: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services estimates that physical therapy codes could see an overall payment increase of 1-3% under the Calendar Year 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Proposed Rule, despite a proposed 1.68% decrease to the conversion factor.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 提议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生费用表显示，物理治疗代码总体支付可能增加 1-3%。尽管转换系数略有下降，但执业费用计算方式的变化将有利于物理治疗师。你应密切关注这一政策进展，以便提前规划诊所财务和运营。
items.titleZh: 提议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生费用表：物理治疗师需知，第一部分
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）估计，根据 2027 财年 Medicare 医生费用表拟议规则，物理治疗代码的总体支付可能增加 1-3%，尽管转换系数拟议下调 1.68%。
items.curatedReasonEn: The proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule from CMS indicates a potential overall payment increase of 1-3% for physical therapy codes. Despite a slight decrease in the conversion factor, changes in practice expense calculations will benefit physical therapists. You should closely monitor this policy development to plan your clinic's finances and operations in advance.
